notes: InkoVideo (inkovideo.de, Germany) is both a surveillance RETAILER (reselling Reolink, EZVIZ, Foscam, HiLook, Dahua/Imou, Annke) and a house BRAND with its own-branded cameras (V-series: V-111/V-116/V-117/V-120/V-125/V-130/V-140 etc.). The dataset's InkoVideo cameras are the house-branded units, which are OEM rebadges: the official INKOVIDEO V-140-8MW user manual (mirrored at asset.re-in.de/.../AN_Inkovideo-V-140-8MW-...pdf and asset.conrad.com; NVR manual likewise) and the V-130-8MW product page (inkovideo.de/netzwerkkamera-inkovideo-130-8mw.html, listing 'ONVIF PROFILE S/G, ISAPI') are unmistakably Hikvision/HiLook-lineage: ISAPI, default HTTP 80 / RTSP 554 / HTTPS 443 / Server-Port 8000, RTSP authentication (basic/disable), Main/Sub/Third stream, H.264 / H.265 / H.264+ / H.265+. So on those units the Hikvision RTSP form (/Streaming/Channels/101 main, /Streaming/Channels/102 sub, port 554) is very likely correct in practice. HOWEVER, no official InkoVideo document (manual, product page, or the hilfe.inkovideo.de support portal, which mostly relays Reolink/Foscam vendor docs) PRINTS a literal rtsp:// URL/path. Per the non-negotiable rule (publish only paths literally confirmed in the manufacturer's own doc), and because InkoVideo spans multiple OEM lineages (Hikvision own-brand + Reolink/Foscam/Dahua resale) with no single unified RTSP scheme, status is 'unverified'. Confirmed from official docs: RTSP is supported on default port 554 with configurable Main/Sub/Third streams; retrieve the exact stream URI per unit via ONVIF (Profile S) GetStreamUri, or use the Hikvision /Streaming/Channels/10<N> form for the Hikvision-OEM V-series. All StrixCamDB leads are unconfirmed against official InkoVideo documentation.
